verdict.rationale: Relay offers high-yield savings accounts on the same platform, earning up to 3.00% APY, and its auto-transfer rules sweep idle cash out of operating accounts into those savings, so funds never leave Relay. A community user confirms earning extra interest on money set aside for taxes. Missing for 10: the APY tiers and qualifying conditions (the footnoted '1' is never explained), yield on the operating checking balances themselves rather than only on swept savings, documentation of the underlying bank or sweep structure, and independent corroboration beyond one brief comment.
